IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL COMPLETION, DEPLOYMENT & VERIFICATION MANDATE

Do not stop at reports. Complete the remaining production work now and return verifiable evidence only.

CURRENT GOAL:
Move IVX from "mostly complete" to "100% production verified."

==================================================================
PHASE 1 — COMPLETE ALL REMAINING WORK
==================================================================

Complete every remaining production blocker:

1. Finish SD-0001 remaining capabilities.
2. Complete emergency-stop runtime wiring.
3. Verify every production deployment policy.
4. Verify GitHub HEAD = Render deployment = /health commit SHA.
5. Verify Render production is LIVE with no crash or restart loop.
6. Verify Supabase production data and synchronization.
7. Verify Owner authentication on the live production environment.

==================================================================
PHASE 2 — MOBILE RELEASE
==================================================================

Complete:

✓ Final Expo Android APK
✓ Google Play signed AAB (if owner credentials are available)
✓ iOS/TestFlight preparation (if Apple credentials are available)

Verify the APK on a real Android device.

==================================================================
PHASE 3 — FULL END-TO-END QA
==================================================================

Manually verify:

✓ Owner login
✓ Logout/Login
✓ Session persistence
✓ Members
✓ Investors
✓ Buyers
✓ Deals
✓ Reels
✓ Chat
✓ Landing registration
✓ Notifications
✓ Admin Dashboard
✓ Owner Dashboard
✓ API
✓ Database
✓ Production health

Do not mark PASS unless each module is actually tested.

==================================================================
PHASE 4 — APP FACTORY
==================================================================

Verify every registered AI agent.

If an agent has not executed real work, mark it NOT VERIFIED.

Activate only verified agents.

Do not claim 50 verified agents unless all 50 have completed real tasks successfully.

==================================================================
PHASE 5 — FINAL EVIDENCE
==================================================================

Return only verifiable production evidence:

• GitHub repository
• Branch
• Commit SHA
• Render Service ID
• Render Deployment ID
• Deployment status
• /health response
• Boot time
• APK build version
• APK SHA256
• AAB status
• iOS/TestFlight status
• Production URLs
• Database verification
• QA checklist
• Remaining blockers (if any)

==================================================================
FINAL RULE
==================================================================

Do not respond with "COMPLETE" unless production evidence confirms the deployment is live and all completed items have been verified.

If any item remains blocked because it requires owner credentials (Google Play, Apple, deploy hook regeneration, etc.), identify it explicitly and provide the exact next step.

Otherwise, complete deployment now and return the final production verification report with evidence.
